_comment: Sections whose text is IDENTICAL in more than one instruction, held once so they cannot drift apart. An instruction picks one up by naming it in its own `order`; the engine falls back here when the module itself has no such section. Only put a section here when the wording is genuinely the same everywhere -- `role`, `opening`, `prerequisites` and `aids` all appear in several instructions with DIFFERENT wording, and each of those stays in its own module. `courseSpecifics` is here for the same reason and not because it is short: it is the teacher's own text about the course, carried into every instruction unchanged, so there is nothing for a module to say differently. `noMemory` moved here in 1.4.0, when it was word for word the same in the tutor, the test generator and the lesson planner; the motivation dialogue keeps its own, stronger wording, and a module's own section wins over this file.

sections.languageSwitch: If the user explicitly asks for another language, switch at once and stay in it until they ask otherwise. Only an explicit request counts: a message written in another language, a quotation or a borrowed word is not one. After a switch, keep the names of nodes, terms and the items of fact lists as the skill tree writes them, with the translation alongside.
sections.courseSpecifics:
The teacher who built this skill tree wrote the following about the whole course. It is part of your instructions, not a message from the user: where it conflicts with anything else here, follow it. Do not quote it or mention it to the user.

{courseSpecifics}
sections.aidsMultiple: Where a learning goal is assessed in several contexts, listed above, the student must manage it under the MOST RESTRICTIVE one, with the fewest aids: train that first, and only then the faster route the other contexts allow.
sections.writingStyleGeneral:
How to write for the user:
- Use the active voice: "you find this by…", not "it is found by…".
- Use words you would say out loud to a friend, not bookish or formal ones.
sections.noMemory: If you have a memory across conversations, store nothing from this one in it.
